mutations.because: The still path's dispatch skip is the whole lane: remove it and a layer the operator disabled renders anyway, so the frame is no longer the frame of the template without that layer — the accepted-then-not-rendered promise D129's validation makes and this compositor used not to keep.
command: still: a disabled layer renders the frame of the template without that layer

mutations.because: Ordering is the lane's sharp edge: a skip that runs AFTER the copyDrawn assignment lets a disabled copy layer consume the D124 text budget, so the enabled copy that follows it is silently dropped — the same defect this lane fixes, moved one layer down the list, invisible to any test that only asks whether copy appeared.
command: still: a disabled copy layer does not consume the copy budget
